title: In JetBrains WebStorm before 2026.3, 2026.2.3 code execution via Grunt and Gulp task loading was possible in untrusted…
description: JetBrains WebStorm versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.3 are vulnerable to code execution via Grunt and Gulp task loading in untrusted projects. This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code when loading these tasks, potentially compromising confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
